acceptance: The complete reviewed source tree is imported into a recovery branch.
The previous main commit remains in history.
All application source and approved assets have an inventory and integrity verification.
Changes pass the checks appropriate to their scope.
Delivery to the existing Sites project uses an exact source commit and verified artifact.
No merge, deployment, access change, or force push is automatic.
publication_policy: A GitHub commit does not prove a Sites deployment.
checkpoint_scope: Preparation record only. This branch is not the current application source.
